=== FILE: gray_counter_equiv.eqy ===
[gold]
read_verilog gray_counter.v
prep -top gray_counter

[gate]
read_verilog gray_counter_refactor.v
prep -top gray_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 20
engine smtbmc
=== END FILE ===

result.detail: The setup file is placed at the root so that it sits beside the approved rtl_source files, which the platform places under their own names. No file is written with those names. Gold and gate scripts differ because they read different files, so the identical-script refusal does not apply. A reviewer mutation test (for example a wrong reset value or a wrong wrap code in the gate) is recommended, per the knowledge document, to show that the setup observes those behaviours. The engine line omits a solver word to avoid an unlisted token; if the gate requires a solver, a resubmission with an allowed solver word would be needed.
